target_task.text: Refining end-to-end vision-language-action policies for robotic manipulation and autonomous navigation through reinforcement learning and trajectory generation.

limitation.text: Online fine-tuning of vision-language-action policies via reinforcement learning often suffers from task collapse, sparse binary reward exploration challenges, and distribution shifts during deployment.

combination.text: Proximal Policy Optimization is used to optimize vision-language-action policies and trajectory generation components, converting sparse rewards or demonstrations into stable policy updates. By integrating PPO with trajectory planning frameworks, policies can better handle dynamic constraints and spatial reasoning tasks without collapsing on individual streams.

summary.text: This opportunity briefing explores combining proximal policy optimization, trajectory planning, and vision-language-action models to refine end-to-end policies for robotic manipulation and autonomous navigation. The integration addresses task collapse and sparse reward challenges during online reinforcement learning fine-tuning. The DVF evaluation yields a feasibility score of 3.0 and a desirability score of 4.0, while viability remains unassessed.
